```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))
if (!exists("SRS.PGA.units", inherits = FALSE)) SRS.PGA.units <- "g"
SRS.range.word <- "a"
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "summary", "srs.R"))
SRS_TARGET_TEXT <- if (!is.na(SRS.config$id) && nzchar(SRS.config$id)) {
  if (tolower(SRS.config$id) == "design") "el espectro de diseño" else paste("el espectro objetivo", SRS.config$id)
} else {
  "el espectro objetivo del proyecto"
}
SRS_SITE_TEXT <- .reportLabel()
if (!nzchar(SRS_SITE_TEXT) && !is.null(params$site) && length(params$site)) {
  SRS_SITE_TEXT <- trimws(as.character(params$site[[1L]]))
}
if (!nzchar(SRS_SITE_TEXT) && !is.null(params$location) && length(params$location)) {
  SRS_SITE_TEXT <- trimws(as.character(params$location[[1L]]))
}
if (!nzchar(SRS_SITE_TEXT)) SRS_SITE_TEXT <- "el proyecto"
```

Para los análisis dinámicos de `r SRS_SITE_TEXT` se seleccionaron `r .fmti(SRS$records)` registros de `r .fmti(SRS$events)` sismos y `r .fmti(SRS$providers)` proveedores usando `r SRS_TARGET_TEXT`, definido para $V_{S30}=$ `r .fmti(SRS.config$Vs30)` m/s y con la banda `r SRS.config$envelope`. La componente H1 final cubre $M_w$ `r SRS$Mw`, distancia epicentral $R_{\mathrm{epi}}$ `r SRS$Repi`, duración significativa $D_{5-95}$ `r SRS$D0595` y PGA `r SRS$PGA`; los coeficientes de escala $c_i$ varían entre `r SRS_SCALE$range`. El RMSE relativo entre la media PSA del conjunto y el espectro objetivo es `r SRS_STAGE$RMSE`, y la razón entre el PGA medio del conjunto y el PGA objetivo es `r SRS_STAGE$pgaRatio`.

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(list = intersect(c(
  "SRS.target", "SRS.selection.text", "SRS.PGA.units", "SRS.range.word",
  "SRS.performance.target",
  "PathSRS", "SrsG", "SRS", "SRS.target.PGA", "SRS.config",
  "SRS_STAGE", "SRS_SCALE", "SRS_PERFORMANCE", "SRS_TARGET_TEXT",
  "SRS_SITE_TEXT"
), ls()))
```
